subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

An lion is the most ferocious of all animals.
solution:
The correct answer is "**An lion.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error is in the part "an lion."
 
• **The correct article to use before "lion" is "a," not "an," because "lion" begins with a consonant sound**.
 
 
• **We use the indefinite article "a" before a singular noun beginning with a consonant sound.**
 
• Example: I own a cat.
 
 
 
• The word "ferocious" is correctly used in this sentence to describe the lion.
 
• "All animals" is a correct and appropriate phrase to use to describe the scope of comparison.
 
• Option 4, "is the most," is also correct and necessary for the sentence to convey its meaning.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
